> 第7章 一起回国（第1页）
容辞身边的两位同事一边偷看林芜，一边忙后退了两步，贴在墙上。
但随即就冷淡的移开了视线，显然是并没有将她放眼里，随即就在几位经理的簇拥下进了电梯。
在电梯门阖上后，容辞两位同事忙舒了一口气，随即又兴奋八卦起来。
“刚才那位应该就是封总的女朋友吧？我靠，好漂亮啊，她身上全是名牌耶，应该很贵吧？不愧是豪门出身，自信从容又有气势，气质跟我们普通人真的有壁耶！”
她们两人说着，又轻声问容辞：“容辞，你觉得呢？”
毕竟，在她八岁时，她的父亲为了不让林芜和她母亲受委屈，执意要跟她母亲离婚，迎娶林芜的母亲。
父母离婚后，她跟着精神失常的母亲一起跟着外婆舅舅一起生活。
这些年，舅舅的生意每况愈下，林家的生意却是蒸蒸日上。
听说为了弥补林芜童年时期所受的委屈，她父亲什么都要给她最好的，花费了无数金钱培养她。
而林芜，也不负众望，听说也非常优秀。
所以，当初的私生女林芜，如今已经是名正言顺的豪门千金了。
做了十多年的千金小姐，这不，现在林芜身上的豪门千金气质，比当初作为真千金的她还要足。
她本以为童年过后，她和林芜不会再有交集。
她和封庭深算是青梅竹马，可不管她怎么努力，封庭深眼里始终都看不到她，却在见到林芜的第一眼，就彻底爱上了她——
见容辞脸色有些苍白，两位同事有些担心。
她和封庭深很快就要离婚了，封庭深爱谁，以后都和她没有关系了。
当天，容辞没有再关注封庭深和林芜之间的事。
她一直加班到差不多九点，在工作差不多忙完时，她手机响了起来，是她闺蜜楚紫岚的电话。

容辞接起，却被告知楚紫岚喝多了，让她过去饭店接她回家。
容辞赶紧把手头上的文件处理好，拿上车钥匙就离开了公司。
下了车，她正要朝着门口方向走去时，另一侧的停车场走出了一个小女孩。
看着小女孩清晰的侧脸，容辞脚步一滞。
她不应该在a国上学吗？怎么会……难道她跟着封庭深一起回国了？
她的身份职位，虽然无法接触到公司的一些机密文件，可她也知道封庭深在a国的开拓工作还需要一段时间才能彻底完成。
她以为封庭深这次只是短暂的回国处理事情。
她没想到女儿居然也跟着回来了……
她不知道他们具体是什么时候回国的，可根据她今天早上就见到了封庭深这一点来判断，到现在他们怎么说也回来了有一天时间了。
可女儿从头到尾都没给她打过电话，告知她他们回国的事。

Mr. Feng, my wife has wanted to divorce you for a long time. The latest chapter_Chapter 7 Returning to China Together Page 1_Mr. Feng, my wife has wanted to divorce you for a long time. Yun Zhongmi_Hot Novel Network
> Chapter 7 Returning to China Together (Page 1)
The two colleagues beside Rong Ci peeked at Lin Wu, then took two steps back and leaned against the wall.
But then he looked away coldly, obviously not taking her seriously, and then entered the elevator surrounded by several managers.
After the elevator door closed, Rong Ci's two colleagues breathed a sigh of relief, and then started gossiping excitedly.
"That one just now must be Mr. Feng's girlfriend, right? Oh my god, she's so beautiful. She's covered in famous brands. She must be expensive, right? She deserves to be from a wealthy family. She's confident, calm and imposing. Her temperament is really different from us ordinary people!"
The two of them were talking and asked Rong Ci softly: "Rong Ci, what do you think?"
After all, when she was eight years old, her father insisted on divorcing her mother and marrying Lin Wu's mother in order to prevent Lin Wu and her mother from being wronged.
After her parents divorced, she lived with her maternal uncle and grandmother, who was mentally ill.
Over the years, my uncle's business has been deteriorating, but the Lin family's business has been booming.
It is said that in order to make up for the grievances Lin Wu suffered in her childhood, her father wanted to give her the best in everything and spent countless money to train her.
Lin Wu lived up to expectations and was said to be very good.
Therefore, Lin Wu, the original illegitimate daughter, is now a legitimate daughter of a wealthy family.
After being a daughter of a wealthy family for more than ten years, no, Lin Wu's temperament as a wealthy daughter is even better than when she was a real daughter.
She thought that after childhood, she and Lin Wu would never meet again.
She and Feng Tingshen were childhood sweethearts, but no matter how hard she tried, Feng Tingshen could never see her in his eyes, but he fell in love with her completely the first time he saw Lin Wu——
Seeing that Rong Ci looked a little pale, the two colleagues were a little worried.
She and Feng Tingshen will divorce soon. Whoever Feng Tingshen loves will have nothing to do with her in the future.
That day, Rong Ci no longer paid attention to the matter between Feng Tingshen and Lin Wu.
She worked overtime until almost nine o'clock. When she was almost done with her work, her cell phone rang. It was the call from her best friend Chu Zilan.
Rong Ci picked up the call, but was told that Chu Zilan had drunk too much and asked her to go to the hotel to pick her up and take her home.
Rong Ci quickly processed the documents on hand, took the car keys and left the company.
After getting out of the car, when she was about to walk toward the door, a little girl walked out of the parking lot on the other side.
Looking at the clear side face of the little girl, Rong Ci hesitated.
Shouldn't she go to school in country A? How could it be...did she return to China with Feng Tingshen?
Although her identity and position did not allow her to have access to some of the company's confidential documents, she also knew that it would take some time for Feng Tingshen's pioneering work in country A to be completely completed.
She thought Feng Tingshen was only returning to China briefly to deal with matters.
She didn't expect that her daughter would come back with her...
She didn't know exactly when they returned to China, but judging from the fact that she saw Feng Tingshen this morning, they had been back for a day.
But her daughter never called her to tell her about their return to China.
Thinking of this, Rong Ci squeezed the bag in his hand and looked at the cheerful little figure in front of him.
